name: Plenoxels Optimization Configuration
definition: Optimizes voxel opacity ($\sigma$) and spherical harmonic (SH) coefficients using gradient-based optimizers with specific learning rate schedules.
summary: Plenoxels Optimization Configuration defines hyperparameters to optimize sparse 3D voxel grids without neural networks, distinguished by its reliance on RMSProp for spherical harmonic coefficients and robustness to learning rate variations.
